description: This Java class defines a singleton implementation of a Function that replaces a placeholder with the subject ID from authorization headers. It provides a method to retrieve the first authorization subject's ID from headers, indicating its role in processing authorization context information within the project.

classes.name: SubjectIdReplacementDefinition
classes.description: A singleton class implementing a Function to extract the subject ID from DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SubjectIdReplacementDefinition.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Extracts and returns the first authorization subject ID from given DittoHeaders.
